en.headline: PPA Asia 1500 Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam begins at Kai Tak Arena
en.dek: The season-ending professional pickleball tournament runs until 25 October with a prize purse of US$1.1 million and players from more than 20 countries.
body: The PPA Asia 1500 Hang Seng Bank Hong Kong Slam 2026 opened at Kai Tak Arena in Kai Tak Sports Park on Monday, the Chung Yeung public holiday.

Organised by F-Sports Promotions Limited and title-sponsored by Hang Seng Bank, with support from the Hong Kong, China Tennis Association, the event is the finale of the 2026 PPA Tour Asia season. It features professional and amateur divisions across singles, doubles and mixed doubles.

According to the organisers, the total prize purse is US$1.1 million, described as the largest in Asian professional pickleball history, with champions eligible for 1,500 ranking points. The tournament runs through Sunday 25 October.

Qualifying matches are scheduled for Monday, with main-draw play from Tuesday to Saturday and finals on Sunday. Tickets for general admission and seated areas are available through Hong Kong Ticketing.

zh.headline: PPA亞洲1500恒生銀行香港大滿貫今起啟德體藝館開打
zh.dek: 賽事為PPA亞洲巡迴賽年度壓軸，至10月25日舉行，總獎金110萬美元，吸引逾20個國家及地區球手參與。
body: PPA亞洲職業匹克球巡迴賽1500・恒生銀行香港大滿貫2026於重陽節公眾假期星期一在啟德體育園啟德體藝館揭幕。
賽事由F-Sports Promotions Limited主辦、恒生銀行冠名贊助，並獲中國香港網球總會支持，是2026年PPA亞洲巡迴賽的賽季終結站。賽事設職業及業餘組別，包括單打、雙打及混合雙打。
主辦機構表示，總獎金達110萬美元，為亞洲職業匹克球史上最高之一，冠軍可爭取1,500個排名積分。賽事一直進行至10月25日星期日。
星期一為資格賽，星期二至六進行正選賽，星期日決賽。普通入場及有座門票可透過香港售票網購買。
